backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing comment list management with single-use device tracking, bulk comment generation with access key validation, and admin functions for creating/managing comment lists.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three high-confidence features related to fixing submit button event handlers and comment generation functionality in production deployment.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components, pages, and hooks including comment generator pages, admin components, and utility hooks.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes with pastel color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx for the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring React Query, theme provider, and TanStack Router with routes for customer view, upload, live list, and admin panel with token gate.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminChatT: Admin interface for managing chat messages with sender/message input form, send functionality, and message history display with timestamps.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminComme: Admin interface for managing comment lists with create/delete list operations, bulk/single comment upload modes, and comment deletion with totals tracking.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminImage: Admin interface for viewing and deleting uploaded rating images in a grid layout with uploader name, timestamp, and delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLiveL: Admin interface for managing live list apps and usernames with create/delete app operations, bulk/comma-separated username upload modes, and reset functionality.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminSetti: Admin interface for managing bulk generator access key with set/reset operations, masked key display, and current status indicator.
frontend/src/components/AdminTokenGate.t: Authorization guard component that checks admin token validity and displays access denied message or loading state before rendering protected children.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedBackdrop: Empty component file for canvas-based animated background (implementation not provided).
Empty component file for glassmorphism audio player (implementation not provided).
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Empty component file for authentication wrapper (implementation not provided).
frontend/src/components/EffectBurst.tsx: Empty component file for visual effects like heart explosions and confetti (implementation not provided).
frontend/src/components/GalleryGrid.tsx: Empty component file for responsive gallery grid (implementation not provided).
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Empty component file for Internet Identity login/logout button (implementation not provided).
frontend/src/components/Rotating3DObject: Component rendering a 3D rotating cube with six colored faces using CSS transforms.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Empty component file for footer with Caffeine.ai attribution (implementation not provided).
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Root layout with fixed background image, top segmented navigation, main content outlet, and footer with Caffeine.ai attribution and UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/SiteNav.tsx: Empty component file for responsive navigation (implementation not provided).
frontend/src/components/TeddyMascot.tsx: Empty component file for teddy bear mascot with animations (implementation not provided).
Sticky navigation bar with icon-labeled buttons for Customer View, Upload Section, Live List Checker, and conditionally-rendered Admin Panel based on admin token validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages backend actor instances with Internet Identity authentication, initializes admin access control with secret token, and invalidates dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminComments.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing comment lists including CRUD operations (create, add, bulk upload, delete, reset) and fetching available lists and their contents.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminToken.ts: Manages admin authentication by checking for a valid token in URL hash or session storage, providing admin access state and token validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useBulkGeneratorKey.t: Provides React Query hooks for managing bulk generator API keys including checking key status, setting new keys, and resetting existing keys.
frontend/src/hooks/useChatMessages.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching all chat messages and adding new chat messages with sender information.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: Provides hooks for generating comments (single or bulk), fetching available comment lists, and checking bulk key status with extensive console logging for debugging.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context and provider for ICP, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient configuration with delegation handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveListChecker.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing live list apps including checking usernames against lists, adding/deleting apps, managing usernames, and resetting data.
frontend/src/hooks/useRatingImages.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing rating images including uploading new images with uploader names, fetching all images, and deleting images by index.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color variables for light/dark themes, utility classes for pastel backgrounds, cards, buttons, and 3D rotating cube animations.
frontend/src/lib/deviceId.ts: Provides utilities for generating and storing a stable device identifier in localStorage, and tracking which comment lists have been used for single-generation on the current device.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin dashboard with tabbed interface for managing comments, images, chat, live lists, and settings with icon-based navigation.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerViewPage.tsx: Customer-facing page for generating single or bulk comments from selected lists, with device-based single-use restrictions and admin access code entry.
frontend/src/pages/LiveListCheckerPage.t: Page for checking usernames against multiple apps' live lists, with localStorage persistence for selections and results, and CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/pages/UploadSectionPage.tsx: Page for uploading rating images with uploader name, featuring progress tracking and success feedback using ExternalBlob for file handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup capabilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system, custom theme extensions, container settings, and plugins for animations and typography.
project_state.json: Project state tracking a data entry application with a known issue where submit button event handlers work in draft mode but fail in production deployment. Contains three features focused on fixing submit button click events, event handler binding consistency, and verifying comment generation functionality in production.
